rules.condition: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house in his or her name or in the name of any family member anywhere in India.

notes: The current profile does not collect house-ownership status, so this condition cannot be evaluated.
PMAY-U has component-specific income and household requirements. The current profile does not collect enough information to evaluate those requirements reliably.
The state field alone cannot determine the residency cut-off conditions mentioned in the guidelines.
